# .github/

GitHub-platform configuration only — nothing here is imported or executed by BrisartAI itself.

```
.github/
└── FUNDING.yml   GitHub Sponsors button configuration
```

`FUNDING.yml` points GitHub's "Sponsor" button on the repository page at `JasonBrisart`. No CI workflows are defined here; automated testing runs locally via `pytest` (see `docs/TESTING.md`).
